scripts.build: yarn workspace @edge-connector/sdk build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/build-worker.ts
scripts.test: yarn build && node --import tsx --test sdk/*.spec.ts runtime/*.spec.ts desktop/*.spec.ts cli/*.spec.ts
scripts.test:coverage: yarn build && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='runtime/**/*.ts' --test-coverage-include='sdk/**/*.ts' --test-coverage-include='cli/**/*.ts' --test-coverage-include='desktop/*.ts' --test-coverage-exclude='**/*.spec.ts' --test-coverage-exclude='**/*.d.ts' --test-coverage-exclude='runtime/generated/**' --test-coverage-include-all sdk/*.spec.ts runtime/*.spec.ts desktop/*.spec.ts cli/*.spec.ts
scripts.test:native: yarn build && node tools/prepare-desktop.ts && cd desktop/src-tauri && cargo test --lib
scripts.generate:api: node --import tsx runtime/generate-api.ts && biome format --write runtime/generated
scripts.desktop:dev: yarn build && node tools/prepare-desktop.ts && cd desktop && tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: yarn build && node tools/prepare-desktop.ts && cd desktop && tauri build
